description: Land Acquisition - Paragahadeniya, Mawathagama D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific parcel of land (Lot No. 01, Kanatigollawaththa - Badahelakotuwawatta) for a public purpose. It provides detailed land descriptions, including extent, location, and claimant information, and outlines the legal process for interested parties to submit compensation claims. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
